subject: Q4 last-push: usage credit to finalize OptiCart POC
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opticart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 last-push: usage credit to finalize OptiCart POC

Hi Samira —

Great chat this morning. OptiCart is trending well on the POC traffic pattern and your team hit the 2nd-week fidelity benchmarks we agreed on. To help you finish the feature validation and move to a GA commitment this quarter, we can offer a one-time usage credit to cover incremental inference spend through Nov 30.

Proposed structure (attached):
- $40k usage credit applied to hosted usage through 2026-11-30
- Credit applies only to production inference tokens (not third-party infra)
- Requires a signed order form and a 12-month GA commitment at the baseline monthly commit we discussed

If this looks good I’ve looped in Marissa to confirm margins and finalize the offer PDF. Can you confirm the name and email we should send the order form to (legal/finance)?

Thanks —
Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachments: none in this message
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 last-push: usage credit to finalize OptiCart POC

Vivek —

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the numbers; a $40k one-time credit on a 12-month commit at the rates you quoted keeps us inside target ACV and gross margin thresholds for this segment. A couple of tight guards:
- Credit must be applied only to hosted API token invoices; no refunds or cash payouts.
- We need a clause that the credit expires 2026-11-30 and any unused portion is forfeited.
- Sales must confirm the baseline commit before we execute the order form.

Ben — fyi on margin. If you want to push higher credit, we need explicit approval from revenue ops. Otherwise I’m good to sign off.

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Highlights (short):
- One-time $40,000 usage credit applied to hosted inference invoices through 2026-11-30.
- Customer signs a 12-month GA commitment at the agreed monthly baseline; credit does not affect committed spend calculation.
- Credit is non-transferable and expires at month-end.

Please review and reply with the legal/finance contact for the DocuSign. Once we have that, I’ll route the order for signatures and confirm invoicing.

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and thanks to Marissa for the prompt review. The structure looks fine to us. Please send the order form to contracts@opticart.com (CC me). A couple of small asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the exact invoice line that the credit will offset so our AR team can map it?
2) We typically require a simple clause that unused credits cannot be applied after expiration; your wording matches that but please keep it explicit in the order form.

If we get the signed order before COB Wednesday our leadership should be able to greenlight the GA start later this month.

Hi contracts team / Samira —

Thanks — attaching the finalized order form and sending the DocuSign envelope for signature: https://docusign.example.com/abcdef123456 (link above).

Quick answers to your questions:
- Credit application: the $40,000 will be issued as a line-level credit on the monthly hosted inference invoice under SKU: RWF-HOST-INFER-TOKENS. Your AR team will see the credit as a negative line item on invoices dated Nov and Dec as the usage occurs; any remaining balance will be reflected on the Nov 30 invoice and set to $0 after expiration if unused.
- Unused credits: clause 3(b) in the order form states unused credits expire on 2026-11-30 and cannot be carried forward.

Next steps:
1) Please review the DocuSign and sign by 2026-11-03 COB to lock the credit in.
2) Once signed, I’ll confirm the envelope ID with finance and schedule a kickoff with your SRE and our Solutions Engineer to transition from POC to GA.

Appreciate the momentum — we’re excited to get OptiCart onto production.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
